detailZones.title: Entry door hardware
detailZones.description: The open doorway shows its curved frame, exposed metal fittings, narrow window and tubular handrail.

detailZones.title: Forward galley
detailZones.description: The galley has wall cabinets above two metal units, three wheeled carts and a coffee pot on the counter.

detailZones.title: Overhead stowage and passenger service unit
detailZones.translation: 头顶行李架与旅客服务单元
detailZones.description: Follow the left bank of overhead lockers and their underside panels to the long ceiling lights.

detailZones.title: Passenger seating
detailZones.description: Rows of blue seats recede beside the aisle. Headrests, seat backs, padded armrests and metal supports can be distinguished at different distances.

detailZones.title: Aisle and floor finish
detailZones.description: The central carpet runs between pale edge stripes. A cream partition and its metal trim separate the aisle from the lavatory.

detailZones.title: Lavatory interior
detailZones.description: The open compartment shows a basin, a dispenser, a closed toilet lid and a metal threshold beneath the doorway.

detailZones.title: Doorway and fuselage side
detailZones.description: At the right edge the metal jamb and rectangular latch housing frame the doorway. A vertical grab rail is fixed beside the curtain.

anchorAudit.rationale: The original cabin vocabulary is preserved across visible points and related words. The carpet, blue rows, coffee pot and lavatory fixtures were located on the released image. Hidden hardware and functions that cannot be distinguished in this wide view stay in the index.
